interactions.description: The declared interaction rows, in authoring/evaluation order.

items.description: One row of the world's interactions section — an authorable property x property (or property x region) -> effect table entry, the A x B -> F chemistry primitive. Evaluated over every carrier pair (or every occupant) each tick with the matched carriers bound as $left/$right, and compiled through the same effect compiler a WorldRule uses, so it rides the same edge/level latch (kept per pair), journal, and undo.

name.description: The interaction's stable name — unique within the section (a separate namespace from Name, so the two may coincide without colliding). A WorldCellName, never $-prefixed — that prefix marks what the engine mints, and nothing mints an interaction.

left.description: A property name, validated against the declared properties registry — every body whose cell in that keyed row reads nonzero is a left carrier.

right.description: For Distance, a second property name, validated the same way as Left. For Region, a placement id carrying a region facet — validated against the declared placements section instead, never against the property registry.

coOccurrence.description: How the two operands' coming-together is detected.

range.description: The distance threshold, for Distance alone — ignored (and unchecked) under Region.

effects.description: The effects applied in order when the interaction fires — see this type's remarks.

mode.description: Whether the interaction fires every tick the co-occurrence holds (Level) or once per crossing (Edge, the default — an interaction that transforms/spawns/despawns almost always wants Edge, for the same reason a rule that writes a row does: level-firing a spawn is a journal entry every tick the co-occurrence holds).
